text:
Estimated by comparing the before and after photos:

- **Spring roll:** about 70% eaten, roughly 70 g and 100 kcal.
- **Sushi:** 1 of 2 pieces eaten, about 30 g and 45 kcal.
- **Fruit salad:** most of it eaten, about 150 g and 70 kcal; some grapes and melon remain.
- **Tofu salad:** all the tofu eaten (about 80 g, 180 kcal), plus a little slaw (30 g, 20 kcal); most of the slaw remains.
- **Sandwich:** one half eaten except part of the bread, about 140 g and 330 kcal; the other half is still wrapped.
- **Coffee:** mostly drunk, about 150 g and 20 kcal.

That totals about 650 g and 765 kcal.
